description:
## Summary
Port the `/name` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/name <label>` sets a human-readable name for the current session. `/name` with no argument shows the current name or a usage warning.

Behavior details:
- `/name my-feature` → strips the `/name ` prefix, calls `setSessionName()`, then shows status: `dim("Session name set: my-feature")`
- `/name` with no argument → if session already has a name, shows it; otherwise shows usage hint
- After naming, the footer's working-directory line updates to show `~ • my-feature` (or the full path with the name appended after `•`)
- The name persists in the session JSON file

## Source References
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 5030 `handleNameCommand()`
- Footer pwd rendering: same file, search for `sessionName` usage in `renderFooter()`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"name"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"name"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/name` dispatch clause; parse inline argument (text after `/name `)
3. Implement handler: no-arg → show current name or usage; with-arg → persist name, show dim confirmation
4. Update footer `pwd` rendering to append `• <name>` when a session name is set
title: Port /name command
